text:
Ash Patel: Heads-up — we need a micro narrative for the benchmark assets by EOD. Focus: latency vs cost tradeoff that resonates with infra and PMs. Keep it 2 visuals max. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Carmen Li: Agree. Two visuals: 1) latency distribution (P50/P95/P99) vs cost per 1k tokens, 2) a small decision flow for routing (fastpath vs econ path). Short headline + 2 bullets for each.
Doug R: For the chart axes use: x=latency (ms), y=cost ($/1k tokens). Show two model clusters: high-throughput quantized and high-accuracy unquantized. Color by SLA tier.
Tara (prod): Can we make the headline: "Pick the right path — latency where it matters, price where it doesn't"? Need one line CTA for webinar sign-up.
Ash Patel: Love the headline. For the second visual (routing flow) I'd sketch: user request -> latency-sensitive? yes/no -> route to: low-latency model / cost-optimized model. Add thresholds: <150ms -> low-latency; otherwise route to econ.
Carmen Li: Draft copy for slide 1: "Latency vs Unit Cost: Real app tradeoffs" Sub bullets: "P95 is the real user experience metric" and "Intelligent routing can cut token spend by 30–60%"
Doug R: Quick data note: use the internal microbench slices for chat-short (seq=64) and long-context (seq=1024). Add small callout: "quantized pipeline reduces cost by ~2.5x for long-contexts"
Tara (prod): Webinar angle: 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A. Title suggestion: "Serving LLMs: How to tune for latency and dollars" Promo copy: one line, 3 benefits, signup link. I can draft landing copy after visuals.
Ash Patel: Ops ask: Carmen, can you produce two PNGs + alt text? Doug, can you confirm the numbers and provide 3 datapoints (P50,P95,P99) for each slice? BenchBot: scheduled microbench job queued: job id 88421. Will post CSV when done. :robot_face:
Carmen Li: Will do PNGs + alt text. Need final numbers by 3pm.
Doug R: Got it. I'll run the slice and paste CSV here when BenchBot finishes.
BenchBot: job 88421 completed — results uploaded: https://internal/bench/88421.csv
Ash Patel: Perfect — once we have the CSV Carmen, assemble the two visual variants: 1) comparison view (two clusters) 2) split-by-workload view (rows for chat-short, long-context). Keep copy tight, no more than 12 words per chart headline.
Carmen Li: Quick design Q: do we include token-cost conversion example (e.g., 1M tokens ~= $X) as a micro-annotation? Helps PMs.
Tara (prod): Yes include a single callout example on slide 1. Use conservative pricing number and note "example".
Ash Patel: Final checklist: visuals, alt text, 1-line webinar CTA, 3 datapoints CSV, and headline/sub-bullets. Target: EOD. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
Doug R: On it.
Carmen Li: On it.
Tara (prod): I'll draft the webinar signup copy and landing outline and drop it here by 5pm.
Ash Patel: Thanks team. We'll iterate on copy tomorrow morning if needed.
